<!--
Keep this issue small enough to review in one sitting and to close with a single focused PR.
Architecture/decision tickets must land before the implementation tickets they unblock.
Delete guidance comments before submitting, but keep every heading.
-->

## Planning ID
<!-- e.g. MEL-041. Must match the ID in docs/planning/github-issue-plan.md. -->

## Purpose
<!-- One or two sentences: what this issue delivers and why it exists now. -->

## User/engineering value
<!-- Who benefits (learner, reviewer, future contributor) and the concrete value delivered. -->

## Background
<!-- Context a contributor refreshing MERN needs: prior issues, decisions, relevant docs/ADRs. -->

## Scope
<!-- Bullet the exact work included. Be specific about files/areas touched. -->

## Non-goals
<!-- What this issue deliberately does NOT do, to keep the PR focused. -->

## Architecture questions to resolve
<!-- Open questions to answer before/while implementing. For pure impl tickets, may be "None". -->

## Implementation notes
<!-- Suggested approach, patterns to follow, gotchas, references to existing code. -->

## Acceptance criteria
<!-- Objective, checkable outcomes. Prefer 3-6 items. -->
- [ ] 
- [ ] 
- [ ] 

## Testing requirements
<!-- What must be tested and how (unit/integration/component/e2e). Name the runner. -->

## Accessibility requirements
<!-- Keyboard, focus, screen-reader, contrast, motion, touch targets. "N/A" only if truly none. -->

## Documentation requirements
<!-- Docs/ADRs/README/JSDoc to add or update. -->

## Dependencies
<!-- Issue IDs that must be done first (blocked by). -->

## Blocks (issues blocked by this)
<!-- Issue IDs that cannot start until this is done. -->

## Suggested labels
<!-- e.g. area:frontend, area:backend, type:feature, type:docs, type:test, a11y. -->

## Suggested milestone
<!-- M1..M14 from docs/planning/implementation-roadmap.md. -->

## Size
<!-- XS / S / M / L / XL -->

## Fits one focused PR? (yes/no)
<!-- If "no", split the issue before starting. -->

## Recommended branch name
<!-- e.g. feat/speech-bubble, docs/domain-model, ci/github-actions. -->

## Draft PR objective
<!-- The single outcome the draft PR should demonstrate for review. -->

## Known risks
<!-- Technical/product risks and mitigations. -->

## Deferred follow-up work
<!-- Explicitly out-of-scope items to capture as future issues. -->
